name: K1 / K1A2
protection: Composite (Chobham-type) armour. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Low flat wedge-shaped welded turret reminiscent of the M1 Abrams, smaller
Six road wheels per side, hybrid hydropneumatic/torsion bar suspension, side skirts
K1A2: new commander sight, IFF panel, combat ID
